judge_reasoning: The model solution is mechanically equivalent to the official solution: it uses the same spells (Uncaged Fury and Savage Alliance) for the same total mana (7), creates the same 3 Clues, buffs Ravenous Intruder identically via sacrifice, and attacks with both creatures, timing the third Clue sacrifice between the first-strike and regular combat damage steps. The order of casting Uncaged Fury and Savage Alliance is swapped relative to the official solution, but since the buffs are additive, this produces an identical final board state (Bearer 6/5 double strike trample). Verifying the math across all blocking distributions (using the fact that Savage Alliance's trample mode targets a player, granting trample to all of that player's creatures, including Ravenous Intruder), total damage equals 19 minus the number of blocking plants, guaranteeing exactly 16 (lethal) when all three plants block, and more than 16 otherwise. This confirms the plan works for all blocking decisions, matching the official solution's outcome.
model_solution:
1. Cast Uncaged Fury targeting Bearer of Overwhelming Truths (it becomes 4/3 with double strike; prowess makes it 5/4). Investigate, creating a Clue.
2. Cast Savage Alliance escalated once, choosing the modes “creatures target player controls gain trample” (targeting yourself) and “deals 1 damage to each creature target opponent controls.” (Bearer becomes 6/5 with double strike and trample; each Plant is now a 1/2 with 1 damage marked.) Investigate, creating a second Clue.
3. Sacrifice both Clues to Ravenous Intruder (it becomes 5/6).
4. Attack with Bearer of Overwhelming Truths and Ravenous Intruder.
5. After first-strike combat damage (Bearer always deals at least 3 damage to the opponent, triggering investigate) but before regular combat damage, sacrifice the new Clue to Ravenous Intruder (it becomes 7/8). Regular combat damage is then dealt.
No matter how the Plants block, the opponent takes exactly 16 (or more) damage.
